name: ltm
description: Org-level memory for coding agents: query a Bank, hydrate Proposals, and promote decisions.

bank_url.title: Bank git URL
bank_url.description: Git URL of the Bank to clone read-only and refresh on a TTL. Leave empty to resolve the Bank from this repo's .ltm.yaml or your user config.

bank_path.title: Local Bank checkout
bank_path.description: Path to a local Bank checkout, used as is with no clone or fetch. Overrides bank_url. For Bank authors testing unmerged Records.

bank_ttl.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
bank_ttl.description: How long a cloned Bank is served before the next git fetch.
